sign.text: KEYSTONE BEAVER. One dam makes a marsh. Three make a lake. Choose.

dialogue.line: Beavers are engineers. They will build where you let them.
Keep the water off the oak roots. Two hundred years of trees, one wet spring.
Wetland is its own world: reeds, sedge, frogs. The island needs it too.

fail_hint.drowned: The old oaks are standing in water. Move the dam downstream.
fail_hint.too_simple: Still only dry land. Let the beavers build.
